quadlet:
[Unit]
Description=AnythingLLM document chat server

[Container]
Image=docker.io/mintplexlabs/anythingllm:latest
UserNS=keep-id:uid=1000,gid=1000
AddCapability=SYS_ADMIN
Volume=/srv/anythingllm/storage:/app/server/storage:Z
Volume=/srv/anythingllm/storage/.env:/app/server/.env:Z
Environment=STORAGE_DIR=/app/server/storage
PublishPort=127.0.0.1:3001:3001

[Service]
Restart=always

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
